definition: used when the answer changes based on the situation
example: Can we ship it this week? Well, it depends on what QA finds.
exampleEs: ¿Podemos lanzarlo esta semana? Bueno, depende de lo que encuentre QA.
cloze: Can we ship it this week? Well, ____ on what QA finds.

definition: a casual way to agree to a plan or suggestion
example: Let's meet at ten tomorrow. Sounds good, see you then.
exampleEs: Nos vemos mañana a las diez. Me parece bien, nos vemos.
cloze: Let's meet at ten tomorrow. ____, see you then.
note: Very common reply in Slack and meetings; no need to say 'It sounds good'.

es: yo me encargo, ya estoy en eso
definition: I will handle this task right now
example: The build is failing again? I'm on it, give me ten minutes.
exampleEs: ¿El build vuelve a fallar? Yo me encargo, dame diez minutos.
cloze: The build is failing again? ____, give me ten minutes.
note: Said when you accept a task immediately.

definition: an informal way to admit a small mistake
example: I sent you the wrong file. My bad, here is the right one.
exampleEs: Te mandé el archivo equivocado. Mi culpa, aquí está el correcto.
cloze: I sent you the wrong file. ____, here is the right one.
note: Informal and for small mistakes only; for serious errors say 'I apologize'.

es: no te preocupes, no hay problema
definition: a friendly way to say something is not a problem
example: Sorry I joined late. No worries, we just started.
exampleEs: Perdón por unirme tarde. No hay problema, apenas empezamos.
cloze: Sorry I joined late. ____, we just started.

definition: a short warning about something that will happen
example: Just a heads up, the server will be down at midnight.
exampleEs: Solo un aviso: el servidor estará caído a medianoche.
cloze: Just a ____, the server will be down at midnight.

definition: used before giving the short version of a story
example: Long story short, the vendor missed the deadline, so we switched tools.
exampleEs: En resumen, el proveedor no cumplió el plazo, así que cambiamos de herramienta.
cloze: ____, the vendor missed the deadline, so we switched tools.
note: Say it first, then give the result.

es: una decisión obvia, algo que ni se piensa
definition: a decision that is very easy because the answer is obvious
example: Free training from the company? That is a no-brainer.
exampleEs: ¿Capacitación gratis de la empresa? Eso es obvio que sí.
cloze: Free training from the company? That is ____.
note: Informal; it describes the decision, not a person.

es: lo esencial, lo que importa al final
definition: the most important fact after considering everything
example: The bottom line is that we need two more engineers.
exampleEs: Lo esencial es que necesitamos dos ingenieros más.
cloze: ____ is that we need two more engineers.
note: In finance it also means net profit.

es: empezar con todo desde el primer día
definition: to start a new job or project quickly and with energy
example: She joined on Monday and hit the ground running.
exampleEs: Ella entró el lunes y arrancó a todo vapor.
cloze: She joined on Monday and ____.
note: Often used for new hires: 'I want to hit the ground running'.

definition: in a very short and simple way
example: In a nutshell, the model predicts which users will leave.
exampleEs: En pocas palabras, el modelo predice qué usuarios se irán.
cloze: ____, the model predicts which users will leave.

es: agarrarle el modo a, aprender a hacer
definition: to learn how to do something after some practice
example: It felt confusing at first, but I'm getting the hang of it.
exampleEs: Al inicio era confuso, pero ya le estoy agarrando el modo.
cloze: It felt confusing at first, but I'm ____.
note: Informal; 'hang' here has no relation to hanging.

es: improvisar, ver cómo salen las cosas
definition: to decide what to do as things happen, without a fixed plan
example: We don't know the weather yet, so let's play it by ear.
exampleEs: Aún no sabemos el clima, así que improvisemos.
cloze: We don't know the weather yet, so let's ____.
note: Not about music in this meaning.

definition: not knowing about recent news or decisions
example: I was on vacation, so I'm a bit out of the loop.
exampleEs: Estuve de vacaciones, así que estoy algo desactualizado.
cloze: I was on vacation, so I'm a bit ____.
note: Opposite: 'in the loop'. 'Loop me in' means 'include me'.

definition: to contact someone briefly to share updates
example: Let's touch base on Friday to review progress.
exampleEs: Hablemos el viernes para revisar el avance.
cloze: Let's ____ on Friday to review progress.

definition: to return to a topic later
example: I don't have the numbers now, but I'll circle back tomorrow.
exampleEs: Ahora no tengo las cifras, pero lo retomo mañana.
cloze: I don't have the numbers now, but I'll ____ tomorrow.
note: Common corporate phrase; people use it when postponing a topic.

es: de acuerdo, con el mismo entendimiento
definition: having the same understanding of a situation
example: Before we start, let's make sure we're all on the same page.
exampleEs: Antes de empezar, asegurémonos de estar todos alineados.
cloze: Before we start, let's make sure we're all ____.
note: Say 'on the same page', never 'in the same page'.

headword: off the top of my head
es: así de memoria, sin pensarlo mucho
definition: from memory, without checking exact facts
example: Off the top of my head, I think the budget is about fifty thousand.
exampleEs: Así de memoria, creo que el presupuesto es de unos cincuenta mil.
cloze: ____, I think the budget is about fifty thousand.
answer: Off the top of my head
distractors: Over the top of my head
Off the back of my head
Out of the top of my head
collocations: off the top of my head
note: Warns that your answer may be imprecise.

definition: a rough estimate of a number
example: Can you give me a ballpark figure for the cloud costs?
exampleEs: ¿Me puedes dar una cifra aproximada de los costos de la nube?
cloze: Can you give me a ____ for the cloud costs?
note: Comes from baseball; 'in the ballpark' means roughly correct.

definition: to discuss something later, privately, not in the meeting
example: This is getting detailed, so let's take it offline.
exampleEs: Esto se está poniendo muy detallado, mejor hablémoslo aparte.
cloze: This is getting detailed, so let's ____.
note: Polite way to stop a side discussion in a meeting.

es: fallar en algo, dejar algo sin hacer
definition: to fail to do something you were responsible for
example: I dropped the ball on that email and forgot to reply.
exampleEs: Fallé con ese correo y se me olvidó responder.
cloze: I ____ on that email and forgot to reply.

es: hacer una diferencia real, tener impacto
definition: to make a noticeable difference in results
example: Small UI tweaks won't move the needle on retention.
exampleEs: Pequeños ajustes de interfaz no cambiarán la retención de forma notable.
cloze: Small UI tweaks won't ____ on retention.
note: Usually used in negative sentences or questions.

es: lo más fácil de lograr primero
definition: an easy task or goal that gives quick results
example: Let's fix the low-hanging fruit before the big refactor.
exampleEs: Arreglemos lo más fácil antes del gran refactor.
cloze: Let's fix the ____ before the big refactor.

es: tragar el trago amargo, hacerlo aunque cueste
definition: to do something difficult or unpleasant that you can't avoid
example: We finally bit the bullet and rewrote the old system.
exampleEs: Por fin nos armamos de valor y reescribimos el sistema viejo.
cloze: We finally ____ and rewrote the old system.

definition: back at the beginning after a failure
example: The test failed, so we're back to square one.
exampleEs: La prueba falló, así que volvimos a empezar.
cloze: The test failed, so we're ____.

definition: something that seems bad but has a good result
example: Losing that client was a blessing in disguise.
exampleEs: Perder a ese cliente resultó ser una bendición.
cloze: Losing that client was ____.
collocations: turn out to be a blessing in disguise

definition: feeling slightly sick
example: I'm feeling a bit under the weather, so I'll skip the meeting.
exampleEs: Me siento un poco mal, así que me salto la reunión.
cloze: I'm feeling a bit ____, so I'll skip the meeting.
note: Used for mild illness, not serious sickness.

es: dar por terminado el trabajo del día
definition: to stop working for the day
example: We've done enough for now, so let's call it a day.
exampleEs: Ya hicimos suficiente por ahora, terminemos por hoy.
cloze: We've done enough for now, so let's ____.
note: Can also mean to stop doing something for good.

es: hacer algo a medias para ahorrar
definition: to do something cheaply or quickly by skipping steps
example: We can't cut corners on security testing.
exampleEs: No podemos ahorrarnos pasos en las pruebas de seguridad.
cloze: We can't ____ on security testing.

definition: please keep telling me about updates
example: Keep me posted if anything changes with the release.
exampleEs: Mantenme al tanto si algo cambia con el lanzamiento.
cloze: ____ if anything changes with the release.

definition: to try something even if you may not succeed
example: I've never used Rust, but I'll give it a shot.
exampleEs: Nunca he usado Rust, pero lo voy a intentar.
cloze: I've never used Rust, but I'll ____.

headword: at the end of the day
es: al final del día, a fin de cuentas
definition: used to introduce the most important point
example: At the end of the day, users just want it to work.
exampleEs: A fin de cuentas, los usuarios solo quieren que funcione.
cloze: ____, users just want it to work.
answer: At the end of the day
distractors: At the end of the night
collocations: at the end of the day

headword: the ball is in your court
es: te toca a ti decidir o actuar
definition: it is now your turn to act or decide
example: I sent you my proposal, so the ball is in your court.
exampleEs: Te mandé mi propuesta, así que ahora te toca a ti.
cloze: I sent you my proposal, so ____.
answer: the ball is in your court
distractors: the ball is on your field
the game is in your court
the ball is at your hand
collocations: the ball is in his court

definition: things you have to do or deal with
example: I can't take that task; I already have a lot on my plate.
exampleEs: No puedo tomar esa tarea; ya tengo mucho pendiente.
cloze: I can't take that task; I already have a lot ____.
note: Use for workload: 'My plate is full'.

definition: to tell someone your idea to get their opinion
example: Let me run it by my manager before I confirm.
exampleEs: Déjame consultarlo con mi jefe antes de confirmar.
cloze: Let me ____ my manager before I confirm.

definition: something that is hard to learn at first
example: This tool has a steep learning curve, but it's worth it.
exampleEs: Esta herramienta es difícil de aprender al inicio, pero vale la pena.
cloze: This tool has ____, but it's worth it.
note: Steep means hard at first; it does NOT mean slow learning.

definition: to start a process or activity
example: Let's get the ball rolling with a quick kickoff call.
exampleEs: Pongamos las cosas en marcha con una llamada de arranque.
cloze: Let's ____ with a quick kickoff call.
note: Used to begin projects or discussions.

definition: to finish something
example: We need to wrap up in five minutes because of the next meeting.
exampleEs: Necesitamos terminar en cinco minutos por la siguiente reunión.
cloze: We need to ____ in five minutes because of the next meeting.

es: echarle la culpa a alguien para salvarse
definition: to blame someone unfairly to protect yourself
example: He threw his teammate under the bus after the outage.
exampleEs: Le echó la culpa a su compañero después de la caída.
cloze: He ____ after the outage.
answer: threw his teammate under the bus
distractors: threw his teammate over the bus
pushed his teammate in the train
left his teammate on the bus

definition: to avoid saying the main point directly
example: Don't beat around the bush; just tell me the issue.
exampleEs: No te andes con rodeos; dime el problema.
cloze: Don't ____; just tell me the issue.

definition: something very easy to do
example: The setup was a piece of cake.
exampleEs: La configuración fue pan comido.
cloze: The setup was ____.
collocations: it was a piece of cake

definition: to make people feel more relaxed at the start
example: He told a joke to break the ice at the meeting.
exampleEs: Contó un chiste para romper el hielo en la reunión.
cloze: He told a joke to ____ at the meeting.

definition: very rarely
example: I only eat fast food once in a blue moon.
exampleEs: Solo como comida rápida muy rara vez.
cloze: I only eat fast food ____.
collocations: happens once in a blue moon
note: Don't use it for 'sometimes'; it means almost never.

definition: a way to tell someone to stay strong in a hard time
example: The release week is tough, but hang in there.
exampleEs: La semana de lanzamiento es dura, pero aguanta.
cloze: The release week is tough, but ____.

definition: to get quickly to the main point
example: I'll cut to the chase: we need more time.
exampleEs: Voy al grano: necesitamos más tiempo.
cloze: I'll ____: we need more time.

definition: to think in a new and creative way
example: To solve this, we need to think outside the box.
exampleEs: Para resolver esto, necesitamos pensar de forma creativa.
cloze: To solve this, we need to ____.
note: Sometimes seen as overused in business.

definition: to understand the mood of a group and act accordingly
example: He didn't read the room and joked during a serious talk.
exampleEs: No supo leer el ambiente y bromeó en una charla seria.
cloze: He didn't ____ and joked during a serious talk.

definition: to make more effort than is required
example: She always goes the extra mile for her clients.
exampleEs: Ella siempre se esfuerza de más por sus clientes.
cloze: She always ____ for her clients.
note: Verb agrees with subject: she goes.

definition: to quickly join a phone or video call
example: Do you have time to jump on a call with the team?
exampleEs: ¿Tienes tiempo de entrar a una llamada rápida con el equipo?
cloze: Do you have time to ____ with the team?

definition: it is not difficult to understand
example: Follow the guide; it's not rocket science.
exampleEs: Sigue la guía; no es tan complicado.
cloze: Follow the guide; ____.
